title: Chapter 831
paragraphs: Chapter 831
Episode 209. Temar's Seventh Tomb - Keytum's Picture (4)
Two of the Ten Knights and five hundred elite knights released their swords all at once. Murakan twisted his body in mid-air to dodge their attacks.
[This is maddening, Frey! You weren't like this. You were the most gentle and rational among the Ten Knights! Why would the merciful Saint of Hamalen do this?]
The Merciful Saint of Hamalen.

Even before Frey joined Runcandel, the saints of a thousand years ago called her by that name. She was born with immense power, but she never wielded it carelessly. She always lived as a guide who pondered how to relieve the world's suffering.

"You didn't just harm the family by overthrowing the ruler, you put the entire world in danger. Now Zipfel will manipulate history at will, and if we can't stop him with our limited power without a ruler, the world will horribly change......”
[But I didn't do it! Ah, right. Vyollo, you're here too. Will you listen to what I have to say? Huh?]

"Murakan, quit your chatter and hide that witch's cat on your back. I see now... why you suddenly turned evil, harmed the ruler, betrayed your family, and killed so many people. You, like Lokia, sided with the witch!"
Vyollo pointed at Shuri with his sword and shouted. Vyollo was a renowned imperial swordsman who changed his name to Runcandel after being inspired by Temar and became one of the Ten Knights.
[Meow?!]

"What did the witch promise you to make you do this? To prevent the destruction of Solderet? Then not only you, but even Solderet may have betrayed us. Yes, that must be it. The guardian dragon would never harm its contractor to the point of death in the first place!"
[Meow, meow, meow, meeeow!]
Shuri cried out as if she was wronged. Shuri was saying in the language of the Blood Ruby Beast that she had been abandoned by her previous owner.
'Ah... I should have put Shuri in the Blood Ruby too. I forgot that Shuri was Heluram's Blood Ruby Beast.'
Jin held out the Blood Ruby to Shuri with a hand on his forehead.
"There's nothing wrong with you, Shuri. Go in and wait. I'll explain everything once this unfair situation is cleared up."
[Meow!]
"You really put the witch's Blood Ruby Beast away when told to hide it. How lightly must you take us to play such tricks, Murakan."

Thwack-! Waves of sword energy relentlessly battered the protective shield. Especially Frey and Vyollo, who rode the gust of the knights' swords, flew close to Murakan, wildly swinging their scale spear and longsword.
"What is this human wearing the clothes of the family? A puppet of the witch, meant to kill us all and use the ruler in her place?"
The spiritual barrier was repetitively ripped apart and restored, Murakan couldn't help but curse out of frustration.
"Please, I beg you, guys. You're too much for me to handle. So please, stop!"

Murakan cried out, almost pleading. The Ten Knights and the others were all but figments of an illustration, they were guardians who embodied the personalities of those they represented, much like Silderay or Sarah from the previous tombs.
Therefore, Murakan didn't want to harm them. This wasn't a situation set up for a trial of a thousand-year contractor, like in the case of Silderay.

"Look at me calmly! If I were that fake guy, would I just dodge or block without retaliating so far? I would have already turned this place into a wasteland. Most of the regular knights would have died as soon as they saw me!"

At his words, the eyes of the Ten Knights wavered for the first time. However, the attack continued, and there was a momentary lapse, perhaps due to their shaken hearts. The Ten Knights realized this immediately and hastily took a defensive stance. Of course, Jin and Murakan didn't take advantage of this lapse.
The reason why Frey and Violero exposed a gap so easily was not due to their lack of skill.
It was because they trusted Murakan so much. Until the fake Murakan betrayed them, Murakan was the being the Ten Knights trusted the most.
"I'm sorry for the late introduction due to the confusing situation, Ten Knights. I'm not a puppet of the witch Heluram, but Vamel. Could you please look at my sword?"
Jin deliberately hid the name, 'Runcandel.'
'It seems better to pretend that Murakan and I are insiders from Solderet.'
Among the situations set up with Murakan on the way, that seemed the best.

In fact, this place is a world inside a painting, you are guardians living in the world painted by Keitam, and we came to correct the corrupted painting and look into the history of a thousand years ago.
Rather than explaining it like this, it seemed to make more sense to say 'someone sent by Solderet.' In some ways, it wasn't entirely untrue.
"That is, Bradamante...!?"

"Yes, it's Bradamante, the brother sword of Barisada. You might ask if this was also part of the scheme. Please check it yourself, I believe you probably know very well that nobody can duplicate the items of Picon Minche."
Jin pulled out Bradamante from his waist and threw it at the Ten Knights. As soon as they caught and examined the sword, there was no doubt it was genuine.
"Bradamante was something Picon Minche couldn't leave incomplete and took with him. Surely you didn't harm him and bring it, did you?"

"Of course not. Please calm down for a moment and I'll explain everything clearly. I'll also clear up the misunderstanding about the witch's cat, Shuri. Murakan, descend for now and secure a position on the ground. It must be tiring for you two to maintain flight through your sword winds."
The Ten Knights hesitated for a moment, but they raised their hands and stopped the attack of the knights.
"......Fine, we'll listen. If you wanted to harm us, you wouldn't have missed the moment when both of us showed a lapse just now. You seem perfectly capable of doing so."
"A transcendent powerhouse, only one step away from creation, the Ten Great Knights recognized Jin's strength in an instant.
"Thank you."
[Ah, thank you, you rascals! Finally, you're listening because the kid spoke up. I was seriously considering whether I needed to beat you up hard to subdue you.]
The group and the Ten Great Knights all descended to the ground.
"Where did you get those clothes? They are similar to ours, but a bit different."
"The clothes are......"
"Caw! As long as I, Dranacus, am here, you can't bring down the Storm Fortress!"
Zwiiing!
Dranacus's strike landed behind Jin and Murakan before the voice. Murakan turned back and parried Dranacus's sword with his tail.
[Ah, this kid again! Ah, it hurts terribly! Hey, hey, just try to swing a follow-up hit. Even you might end up getting your jaw shattered, Dranacus.]
"Stop it, Dranacus."
"Stop it, Dranacus!"
Three people stopped Dranacus at the same time. Dranacus tilted his head, stopping his sword that he was about to swing again.
"Huh? Frey, what's going on? We were definitely in the middle of a fight in the air just now. Somehow we shook off Murakan and brought it to a ground battle, didn't we?"
"That's not it, this person named Vamel and Murakan are saying things that are not ordinary, so we tried to talk......"
"Keep quiet, Vyollo. I asked Frey, didn't I?"
"Huh, okay. Listen to Frey."
"We tried to talk. After all, what this young man and Murakan are saying seems unusual."
"Ah, I see. I got it. If Frey says so, it must be so."
"No, I said the same thing as Frey."
"Keep quiet, Vyollo. Do you want to get hit? So what's not to your liking?"
At that time, there were only four people in the world who could handle Dranacus. Temar, Frey, the housekeeper Ruet, and the Black Dragon Misha.
"Frey, this guy was babbling strange things to me a while ago. He said he was fake, no. He said he was the real one, right? That's the content, right?"
"That's correct."
The Ten Great Knights stared at Jin and Murakan for a while.
"... I am a person left behind by Solderet in anticipation of such a day. And everything we've said so far is true. The Murakan who attacked Lord Temar is fake, and the Murakan here is the real one."
Jin spoke, showing off the energy in his palm and unbuttoning his shirt to reveal his heart.

"You must have heard from the knights about Lafrarosa from Lord Temar. I spent my time there training under the Myeongwang tribe, and one day Solderet suddenly came looking for Lafrarosa with an unconscious Murakan. Solderet said that the enemies had duplicated Murakan."
Jin continued the story, gauging the mood of the Ten Great Knights.

"Even Solderet didn't know how they duplicated Murakan. However, it's certain that the real Murakan here was duped by the fake while no one knew, and the fake had been mixed in with Runcandel since then, pretending to be real."
"...So when the opportunity came, the fake stabbed Temar in the back?"

"According to what I heard from Solderet, yes. I don't know the detailed inside story any more than that. I'm just a person prepared for Solderet's contingency, and Murakan was unconscious until he left Lafrarosa with me."
[Yes, I lost some memory because I was fooled by the fake. I've almost regained my strength, but there's a slight problem in my head. Hmm.]
"Hah? So is that why you said it's been a long time since you've seen me? How could I forget you, you definitely told me that."
[Yes, Dranacus.]
"But we have never heard about you from the Lord, Vamel. Besides, if Solderet knew that Murakan was a fake, why didn't he inform the Lord or us?"

"He probably didn't have the time while trying to save the dying Murakan. I was just training in Lafrarosa and got the order, so I don't know the exact reason. And Solderet has kept my existence secret so far. Solderet seemed to consider me a kind of... hmm... secret weapon."
"...Secret weapon?"
[Yes, secret weapon! This is the time to use this little guy, so Solderet sent support. As you've seen, this guy is incredibly strong.]
"It's a hard story to understand, Vamel."
"Yes, I think so too. But I believe the important thing is not words but actions. And what I will show you with my actions is the execution of the fake Murakan who harmed Lord Temar."
Jin locked eyes with the Ten Great Knights and added this.
"So, please allow Murakan and me to fight together. You won't be disappointed."
